summary.en: The DR Congo military court has sentenced 66 soldiers to death for cowardice and mutiny after they fled fighting rebels, intensifying pressure on FARDC as FRN rebels advance on multiple fronts. Allied Democratic Forces militants attacked Cantine in North Kivu, raising fears of Ebola spread as patients flee treatment centres. ISIS-linked militants killed 33 people, prompting the Africa CDC to call for a humanitarian corridor to protect Ebola response. Gold smuggling is reported to finance the Islamic State-linked insurgency in the region. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den demokratiske republikken Kongo militærdomstol har dømt 66 soldater til døden for feighet og opprør etter at de flyktet fra kamp mot opprørere, noe som øker presset på FARDC mens FRN-opprørerne rykker frem på flere fronter. Allierte demokratiske styrker-militante angrep Cantine i Nord-Kivu, og frykt for spredning av ebola vokser ettersom pasienter flykter fra behandlingssentra. ISIS-tilknyttede militante drepte 33 personer, og Africa CDC oppfordrer til en humanitær korridor for å beskytte ebolaresponsen. Gullsmugling rapporteres å finansiere den IS-tilknyttede opprøret i regionen. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
